findings.label: presignSchema lower-boundary gap
findings.detail: presignSchema has size: z.number().int().min(1) but no test covers size: 0 or size: -1. Add two cases to prevent regressions if the min constraint is accidentally removed.

findings.label: Self-referential `to` assertion in email.test.ts
findings.detail: The 'sends to ADMIN_EMAIL' test asserts callArg.to === process.env.ADMIN_EMAIL ?? 'admin@example.com', but ADMIN_EMAIL was just assigned in the same test so the assertion is tautological. Assert the literal string 'admin@example.com' instead.

findings.label: toBeAttached() instead of toBeVisible() in filter assertion
findings.detail: search.spec.ts uses toBeAttached() for the filter-element check. A hidden element passes this assertion, so a CSS regression hiding the filters would go undetected. Use toBeVisible() instead.
